spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border, prominent use of neon green on active states

surface_strategies.hero: Dark void with abstract neon green elements, glowing text, heavy use of black space.
surface_strategies.cards: Retro-Futurism / Terminal look. Deep black or charcoal backgrounds, border-white/10 or border-green-500/30. Sharp corners or very subtle rounding (2px-4px).
surface_strategies.glass: Dark glass (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10) for headers and floating elements.
surface_strategies.effects: Subtle green glows (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,65,0.4)]) on primary actions or critical data. CSS scanlines for the AI analysis container.

components.buttons: Flat, high contrast. Primary: Neon green bg with black text, hover state adds a stronger neon glow. Secondary: Transparent with neon green border.
components.inputs: Dark background (bg-[#121212]), thin gray borders, focus state illuminates border to neon green.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons or Lucide with neon green styling for accents.
components.loaders: ASCII art loaders or matrix-style cascading green text.

animation_and_motion.hover: Slight lift, border transitions to neon green, subtle text-shadow or box-shadow glow.
animation_and_motion.reveal: Typewriter effect for AI analysis text to mimic terminal output.
animation_and_motion.page: Fade in with slight upward translation.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark hacker cyber forensic background, glowing neon green data streams.

roulette_noir.description: Close up of a roulette wheel in deep shadows with glowing neon green highlights.

security_lock.description: Glowing green neon padlock and shield on a digital grid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Electric & Neon green and black color palette. Do NOT use purple, blue, or other gradients.
Ensure all text remains highly readable against the dark background. Use #FFFFFF for primary text and #00FF41 for highlights/accents.
Implement the UI with a 'terminal' or 'investigative' aesthetic: sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm), thin glowing borders, and monospace font for data or body.
Use 'Unbounded' for large headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for body and technical data.
Use the provided media URLs exclusively. Do not use generic placeholders.
Implement the dashboard using a dense 'Control Room' grid pattern, utilizing full-height panels and minimal gaps.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
